title: BBQ Chicken Mac n Cheese

ingredients.item: salt and freshly cracked black pepper

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat.

Slice the chicken lengthways into thin, even strips, then cut across into small-to-medium pieces so they all cook at the same rate. Grate the cheese on the large holes of a box grater and roughly chop the parsley.
In a large bowl, toss the chicken with the onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, thyme, oregano, chili flakes, 2 tsp of the oil, a pinch of salt and plenty of black pepper until evenly coated.
Salt the boiling water, add the macaroni and stir so it doesn't clump. Cook for 1 minute less than the packet says, then drain.

Meanwhile, heat a large pan over high heat until very hot. Add the remaining 2 tsp oil and the chicken, scraping in all the spices, and spread it into one layer. Work in batches if the pan is crowded so the chicken sears instead of stewing.

Leave it untouched for 2 minutes to form a crust, then stir only occasionally until just cooked through, about 4½ minutes in total. Stir in the BBQ sauce and cook 1 minute more to glaze. Tip the chicken into a bowl.

Put the pan back over medium-high heat without wiping it. Add the cream or milk, cream cheese, cheddar, a pinch of salt and some pepper, and stir to break up the cream cheese and melt everything. Add the optional sauce spices now if using.
Once it simmers, drop the heat to medium so it doesn't over-reduce, and cook 2–3 minutes until the sauce thickens.

Add the drained pasta and stir over medium heat until every piece is coated. Fold the BBQ chicken through for about 30 seconds, until evenly mixed. (Or keep the chicken and mac separate if you prefer.)
Divide between 6 containers and garnish with parmesan, parsley and black pepper.

To store, cool for 15–20 minutes before putting the lids on. Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge or about 3 months frozen; thaw frozen portions overnight in the fridge. Reheat in the microwave or a pan with a splash of water or stock.
